Name: Ore Increase V3 - Ore Generation Tweaker - More Cinder Shards
Author: kkramer85
Description:
This mod will allow you to increase the amount of ores that spawn in the Mines, Skull Caverns, Hard Mode Mines, and the Volcano Dungeon on the Island. The Mines, Hard Mode Mines, and Skull Caverns share their configuration settings while the Volcano Dungeon can be configured independently.

This allows you to target specific ores or all of the ores if you prefer. This is done by the Regen Attempts settings which determines the number of times the games code will be executed to determine what stone type is placed on a tile. The amount of ore generated will not be affected, simply the number of ore nodes placed in lieu of stone.

For the Volcano Dungeon this mod works slightly different, as the stone/ore generation is more geared towards clusters of ore. Increasing the attempts will exponentially increase the amount of ore that is spawned, and will make more nodes spawn than it would have originally, creating a challenge to run through.

This is my first Mod, and my first release of Version 2 was very limited in functionality and Version 3 is a large expansion of that effort. Please let me know if there are any additional features you would like to see added to this Mod.

Version 3.1.6 now supports Stardew Valley 1.6 - Sorry for the delay in updating!

Version 4.0.0 is now live and includes the i18n files. These translations have not been fully tested or validated, ChatGPT was used to generate the translation files. Please post any updated translations in the posts section and I can update them as time permits.
